Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, s As String, i As Long
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 100, 50, 120, 60).Name = "A"
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        s = TypeName(ws.Shapes("A").Duplicate)
    Case 1
        s = ws.Shapes("A").Duplicate.Name
    Case 2
        ws.Shapes("A").Duplicate: ws.Shapes("A").Duplicate
    Case 3
        ws.Shapes("A").Duplicate: ws.Shapes(2).Duplicate
    Case 4
        ws.Shapes("A").AlternativeText = "d": ws.Shapes("A").Rotation = 30: ws.Shapes("A").Flip msoFlipHorizontal: ws.Shapes("A").Duplicate: s = ws.Shapes(2).AlternativeText & "," & ws.Shapes(2).Rotation & "," & ws.Shapes(2).HorizontalFlip
    Case 5
        ws.Shapes("A").Left = 5: ws.Shapes("A").Top = 3: ws.Shapes("A").Duplicate
    Case 6
        ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeOval, 300, 50, 40, 40).Name = "B": s = TypeName(ws.Shapes.Range(Array("A", "B")).Duplicate)
    Case 7
        ws.Shapes("A").Name = "Box": ws.Shapes("Box").Duplicate
    Case 8
        ws.Shapes.AddTextbox(msoTextOrientationHorizontal, 300, 200, 80, 30).TextFrame.Characters.Text = "hi": ws.Shapes(2).Duplicate
    Case 9
        ws.Shapes("A").Rotation = 30: ws.Shapes("A").Flip msoFlipVertical: s = ws.Shapes("A").Rotation
    Case 10
        ws.Shapes("A").Rotation = 30: ws.Shapes("A").Flip msoFlipHorizontal: ws.Shapes("A").Flip msoFlipHorizontal: s = ws.Shapes("A").Rotation
    Case 11
        ws.Shapes("A").Flip msoFlipHorizontal: s = ws.Shapes("A").Rotation
    End Select
    For i = 1 To ws.Shapes.Count: s = s & "|" & ws.Shapes(i).Name & "," & ws.Shapes(i).ID & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Left & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Top & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Width & "," & ws.Shapes(i).Height: Next
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 11
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
